scientific_integrity: All-order constructive proof and matched universal lower bound; independent standalone finite BFS and direct forcing verifiers included. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The power-domination criterion and optimum counts were published previously; this finding is restricted to even triangular graphs and adjacency-preserving minimum-placement slides. Shortest-path multiplicities and other graph families are not classified; historical priority remains subject to independent review.
title: Exact shortest local sensor relocations on all even triangular graphs
